Freeship card is a declaration by the Government that student is eligible for scholarship under Post-Matric Scholarship schemes of ST & SC Development Department as per prevailing rates/guidelines of the Department.

From AY 2021-22 onwards, Freeship Card will be issued to Fresh Applicants (New registrations/ registered user applying scholarship in new course) and once issued, this shall remain valid for entire duration of course.

Interested eligible ST & SC students can apply for freeship card in Odisha State Scholarship Portal (OSSP) by providing basic eligibility documents i.e. income certificate and caste certificate and basic profile details.
Upon verification, the District Welfare Officer of domicile district will approve Freeship Card which can be downloaded by student from her/ his login.

Institutions shall allow admission to Freeship Card holders without prepayment of fee considering that student undertake to reimburse the fee upon receipt of scholarship amount as per prevailing rates/guidelines. However, any residual payment, if needed, will required to be paid by the student to the institute.
The issuance of Freeship Card only will not ensure payment of scholarship unless scholarship application is made in OSSP and is sanctioned by concerned DWO.
